test_added: src/wasm/app_wire.test.mjs: drives the real wireSudokuApp over an id/listener shell and asserts View -> Show Pencil Marks' `disabled` is false, then true after the Settings dialog's auto_pencil row changes, then false again when it flips back — without calling any sync hook by hand. src/wasm/menus/menu_bar.test.mjs: syncMenuBar sets viewMarks.disabled from config.auto_pencil (false off, true on). src/wasm/play_pad.test.mjs: the same flip through wireSettingsMenu's own onChange. src/native/ascii/renderer.zig: showMenu draws '15) Show Pencil Marks (unavailable)' from the config table's label while auto_pencil is on, the pick falls through to Quit, and no 'invalid menu choice' is printed.
concerns: Test that cannot fail for the change it covers: app_wire.test.mjs never exercises the onChange wiring that ad9dd96 exists to add. Reverting both of that commit's production hunks (`git checkout -- src/wasm/app_wire.js src/wasm/menus/settings.js`) leaves the test green (app_wire.test.mjs OK, play_pad.test.mjs OK). The item is already greyed when the assertion runs, because wireSettingsMenu's click handler is synchronous up to `await` and syncSettingsFields runs before the dialog's first await, so syncControls (app_wire.js:122) reaches syncMenuBar with the new Config before row.onchange() yields. The commit's claim that both suites print the assertion under `git stash push -- src/wasm/app_wire.js src/wasm/menus/settings.js` is therefore false as reproduced here. No test asserts that a Settings change reaches the View item after the dialog closes, which is the defect the commit says it mends; closing the dialog (dismiss handler, settings.js) still runs no sync, and nothing else re-syncs.
red_on_revert: Production changes reverted by `git checkout --` on the touched files, tests kept, then run. (1) src/wasm/menus/menu_bar.js `disabled = config?.auto_pencil === true` forced to `false`: all three web suites fail — app_wire.test.mjs and play_pad.test.mjs with 'AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Show Pencil Marks is unavailable while Auto Pencil is on', menu_bar.test.mjs likewise. (2) src/native/ascii/renderer.zig: the `(unavailable)` row and the `showMenu(cfg)` pick guard removed (and the now-unused `marks_available` const dropped, else 'error: unused local constant'): `zig test src/_one_test.zig -lc --test-filter "unavailable and its pick is ignored"` prints 'expected: set_config' / 'found: quit' / 'FAIL (TestExpectedEqual)' at renderer.zig:1585, '1 passed; 0 skipped; 1 failed.' (3) Reverting only ad9dd96's src/wasm/app_wire.js and src/wasm/menus/settings.js hunks: app_wire.test.mjs OK, play_pad.test.mjs OK — the fix is not covered.
